sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE SUMMER BLOCKING PATTERN WILL PERSIST FRIDAY WITH DOMINANT UPPER RIDGE OVER THE CNTRL U.S. FLANKED BY MEAN TROUGHS OVER THE WRN AND NERN STATES. THE CUTOFF UPPER LOW OFF THE OREGON COAST WILL FINALLY EJECT NEWD THROUGH OR AND WA IN RESPONSE TO UPSTREAM LOW MOVING SWD OFF THE COAST OF BRITISH COLUMBIA. WEAK COLD FRONT FROM VA INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY WILL MOVE SLOWLY SWD. FARTHER NORTH ANOTHER COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY IN RESPONSE TO A PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH NOW MOVING THROUGH MANITOBA. TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL STALL OVER CNTRL/ERN MT.

sections.title: SERN STATES THROUGH MID ATLANTIC
sections.text: MCS CURRENTLY MOVING SWD THROUGH KY INTO TN SHOULD WEAKEN THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY MORNING. HOWEVER...REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY SERVE AS FOCUS FOR ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES. DIABATIC WARMING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH 70S DEWPOINTS SHOULD SUPPORT 1500-2500 J/KG MLCAPE...WITH THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY EXPECTED OVER WRN PORTIONS OF THE SERN STATES WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE HAS NOT EXPERIENCED WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND ALSO EXISTS ON THE ERN EDGE OF SLIGHTLY BETTER MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. STORMS WILL INITIATE BY LATE MORNING FROM THE SERN STATES INTO THE MID ATLANTIC WITH RESIDUAL BOUNDARIES AND HIGHER TERRAIN SERVING AS FOCH FOR MORE NUMEROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT. WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT MULTICELLS WITH ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THE PRIMARY THREAT.

sections.title: NERN WA THROUGH NWRN MT
sections.text: DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH EJECTING UPPER LOW AND STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL PROMOTE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN MT AS DIABATIC WARMING COMMENCES FRIDAY AFTERNOON. ELY LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE WINDS WILL PERSIST IN POST FRONTAL REGIME WHERE 50S DEWPOINTS WILL EXIST BENEATH STEEP LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING 500-1200 J/KG MLCAPE. SHEAR WILL INCREASE TO 40+ KT IN ASSOCIATION WITH MID LEVEL JET ACCOMPANYING THE UPPER TROUGH. ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS. OTHER HIGH BASED STORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP FARTHER EAST OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SRN MT AND NRN WY AND POSSIBLY INTENSIFY AS THEY INTERCEPT THE STATIONARY BOUNDARY.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: STRONG HEATING WILL OCCUR SOUTH OF A STATIONARY FRONT THAT WILL EXTEND EASTWARD ACROSS NRN SD AND INTO NWRN MN DURING THE AFTERNOON. WITH UPPER RIDGE IN PLACE...LARGE SCALE FORCING WILL BE WEAK...BUT AT LEAST ISOLATED STORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM SERN MT INTO THE SD BLACK HILLS WITH ISOLATED WIND AND HAIL AS BACKED LOW LEVEL ELYS WILL BE FAVORABLY JUXTAPOSED BENEATH MODEST SWLYS ALOFT. THERE IS SOME CHANCE THAT THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY MOVING NWD OUT OF THE GREAT BASIN COULD AUGMENT STORM COVERAGE AS IT TURNS NEWD OVER TOP OF UPPER RIDGE. FARTHER EAST...OTHER STORMS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING WITHIN THE ZONE OF WARM ADVECTION ALONG SWLY LLJ. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY BE ELEVATED WITH LIMITED SEVERE POTENTIAL. THE ATMOSPHERE WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE ALONG AND WEST OF THIS BOUNDARY AS DIABATIC WARMING COMMENCES. HOWEVER...WARMING ALOFT WITH THE EWD ADVECTING EML AND PROXIMITY OF UPPER RIDGE MAY SERVE TO CAP THE BOUNDARY LAYER TO SFC BASED STORMS OR AT LEAST LIMIT STORM COVERAGE...SO WILL MAINTAIN 5% SEVERE PROBABILITIES AT THIS TIME. ANOTHER AREA OF POTENTIAL DEVELOPMENT WILL BE ALONG SEWD MOVING FRONT ACROSS NORTHERN MN. CONVECTION THAT FORMS HERE MAY BE AIDED BY A SWLY LOW LEV

sections.title: SRN AZ
sections.text: MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE INTO THE REGION THROUGH FRIDAY WITH AID OF A WESTWARD-MOVING IMPULSE OVER NORTHERN MEXICO. ON THE PERIPHERY OF THE CENTRAL ROCKIES/PLAINS UPPER RIDGE...AN INCREASINGLY EASTERLY STEERING COMPONENT ACROSS SOUTHERN AZ MAY ALLOW STORMS TO SPREAD INTO THE DESERT FLOOR FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING...WITH ASSOCIATED POTENTIAL FOR DOWNBURSTS WITHIN A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER. ..DIAL/LEITMAN.. 07/20/2012

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC TODAY
sections.text: THE REMNANTS OF AN OVERNIGHT MCS ACROSS MIDDLE TN CONTINUE TO SPREAD SWD INTO NRN AL...WHILE OTHER CONVECTION DEVELOPS IN A BAND NEAR THE LA COAST IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE WEAK NOCTURNAL LAND BREEZE AND A MIDLEVEL CYCLONIC SHEAR AXIS. THE STRONGEST SURFACE HEATING TODAY WILL OCCUR NW OF THE ONGOING COASTAL STORMS AND W/SW OF THE REMNANT TN/AL MCS...ALONG AND S OF A WEAK FRONT THAT WILL DRIFT SWD INTO WRN TN AND AR. THE ERN EXTENT OF THE SURFACE TEMPERATURES APPROACHING 100 F WILL OVERLAP WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS NEAR 70 F ACROSS NRN MS/SRN AR/NRN LA...SUPPORTING MLCAPE AOA 3000 J/KG...AND DCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG. NLY MIDLEVEL FLOW AND SWLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL SUPPORT SWD/SWWD-MOVING CLUSTERS OF STORMS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR MULTIPLE STRONG/DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS ALSO LIKELY TODAY FROM CENTRAL AL/GA NEWD TO CENTRAL/SE VA...ALONG THE SE EDGE OF THE THICKER CLOUDS AND WITH ANY REMNANT MCV EMERGING FROM THE OVERNIGHT TN/AL MCS. BOTH SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND LAPSE RATES ALOFT WILL BE LOWER COMPARED TO AREAS FARTHER W INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY...THUS BUOYANCY WILL BE WEAKER. PULSE-TYPE STORMS ARE EXPECTED IN THE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR ENVIRO

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES TODAY
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER WRN ORE WILL EJECT NEWD TO NRN ID/WRN MT BY THIS EVENING...IN RESPONSE TO THE APPROACH OF AN UPSTREAM LOW W OF VANCOUVER ISLAND. RESIDUAL BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 55-60 F ACROSS ERN WA/NRN ID AND SURFACE HEATING WITHIN CLOUD BREAKS WILL SUPPORT WEAK-MODERATE INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON /MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J PER KG/. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED IN THE 18-21Z TIME FRAME ACROSS ERN WA/NRN ID IN THE ZONE OF ASCENT PRECEDING THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH AND COLD FRONT...WITH STORMS SPREADING INTO WRN MT THEREAFTER. THE COMBINATION OF MODEST INSTABILITY AND 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR OF 35-50 KT WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA OVER SE ID/UT/WRN WY WILL ROTATE NEWD OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON...AROUND THE NW PERIPHERY OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS HIGH. ERN MT/NE WY/WRN SD WILL LIE IN THE ENELY UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME IN THE WAKE OF FRONTAL PASSAGE ASSOCIATED WITH THE PRONOUNCED MIDLEVEL TROUGH CROSSING CENTRAL/NRN MB. ONE UNCERTAINTY FOR THIS AREA WILL BE THE IMPACT OF CLOUDS ON DAYTIME HEATING...AND THE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY IN THE POST-FRONTAL AIR MASS. THE MORE PROBABLE AREA FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE ALONG THE FRONT INVOF THE BLACK HILLS...WHERE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES/SUPERCELLS...AND AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS AND WRN/NRN MN THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: ONGOING WAA THUNDERSTORMS OVER ERN SD/SE ND WILL LIKELY DISSIPATE BY LATE MORNING/MIDDAY. AN ASSOCIATED WEAK MIDLEVEL WAVE WILL MOVE SEWD FROM ERN ND TO MN...AS A SURFACE COLD FRONT PROGRESSES SEWD INTO SD/MN. IT APPEARS THAT LOW-LEVEL ASCENT ALONG THE FRONT...IN COMBINATION WITH DAYTIME HEATING AND POTENTIALLY STRONG INSTABILITY...WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS NRN MN THIS AFTERNOON. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE AT LEAST MARGINALLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS...AND THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS FOR A FEW HOURS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.

sections.title: SE AZ THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A WEAKENING MIDLEVEL LOW JUST S OF ELP WILL MOVE WNWWD TO SE AZ BY TONIGHT. INCREASING LOW-MIDLEVEL MOISTURE WILL ACCOMPANY THIS WAVE...AND THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BECOME MORE FAVORABLE FOR STORMS TO FORM OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SE AZ THIS AFTERNOON AND SPREAD WWD OVER THE LOWER DESERTS ON 15-20 KT ELY MIDLEVEL FLOW. GIVEN THE TYPICAL INVERTED-V BOUNDARY LAYER PROFILES...A FEW STRONG OUTFLOW GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. ..THOMPSON/MOSIER.. 07/20/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE UPR GRTLKS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS/BLACK HILLS VCNTY...

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE NRN ROCKIES
sections.text: ...NRN ROCKIES... MID-LVL TROUGH OVER WRN ORE/WA WILL BE KICKED NWD BY A DIGGING VORT MAX OFF VANCOUVER ISLAND TODAY/TONIGHT. RECENT RAINS AND INJECTION OF TROPICAL MOISTURE ALOFT WILL HELP MAINTAIN HIGH PWATS AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEW POINTS AT LEAST IN THE MID 50S OVER ERN WA INTO NWRN MT. TSTMS ONGOING ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN WA/NCNTRL ORE AT 16Z ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE/DEVELOP FARTHER E INTO NRN ID AND ERN WA 18-21Z. AS THE TAIL END OF THE AFOREMENTIONED TROUGH GRAZES THE MOIST UPSLOPE REGIME OCCURRING OVER NCNTRL/WRN MT...OTHER STORMS WILL DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTN. BULK SHEAR OF 35-50 KTS AND MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY WILL FAVOR ISOLD SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS AN ISOLD TORNADO. OTHERWISE...ACTIVITY WILL EVOLVE INTO FAST MOVING LINEAR SEGMENTS GIVING HIGH WINDS/HAIL THIS EVE OVR NCNTRL/NWRN MT.

sections.title: LWR MS VLY TO MID ATLANTIC
sections.text: 16Z MESOANALYSIS SHOWED A CDFNT EXTENDING FROM SRN VA WWD INTO THE MID-OH VLY AND THEN SWWD INTO NRN OK. TO THE N OF THE FRONT...WIDESPREAD CLOUDS WILL MITIGATE HEATING/ DESTABILIZATION...ESPECIALLY FROM NC/VA BORDER NWD. INSTABILITY AND HEATING WILL BE MORE SUBSTANTIAL ALONG WRN EXTENTS OF THE FRONT WITH MLCAPES LIKELY REACHING 4000 J/KG FROM NWRN AL WWD TO THE MS DELTA REGION. TSTMS WILL GRADUALLY EVOLVE ALONG THE CDFNT...MORE READILY FROM AL WWD INTO MS WHERE A SWD MOVING MCV/SHEAR AXIS TRANSLATES SWD MODULATING LLVL CONVERGENCE. DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...PERHAPS STRONGER VCNTY THE MCV OVER PARTS OF AL/MS. AS A RESULT...MULTICELL CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS WILL BE PRIMARY MODE. FCST SOUNDINGS EXHIBIT CONSIDERABLE DCAPE OF 1500 J/KG. WATER LOADING AND FAVORABLE MEAN NLY FLOW ATOP SFC SWLYS WILL PRODUCE A FEW DMGG WIND GUSTS. FARTHER TO THE NE...CLOUD COVER AND COMPARATIVELY WEAKER MID-LVL LAPSE RATES WILL POSE PROBLEMS FOR STRONG DESTABILIZATION. NONETHELESS...PULSE-TYPE STORMS WITH ISOLD DMGG WINDS/HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED ALONG THE FRONT/LEE TROUGH FROM NRN GA NEWD INTO PARTS OF NC.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA OVER SE ID/UT/WRN WY WILL ROTATE NEWD OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON...AROUND THE NW PERIPHERY OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS HIGH. ERN MT/NE WY/WRN SD WILL LIE IN THE ENELY UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME IN THE WAKE OF FRONTAL PASSAGE ASSOCIATED WITH THE PRONOUNCED MIDLEVEL TROUGH CROSSING CENTRAL/NRN MB. THE MORE PROBABLE AREA FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE ALONG THE FRONT INVOF THE BLACK HILLS...WHERE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES/ SUPERCELLS...AND AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: UPPER GRTLKS REGION
sections.text: ELEVATED CONVECTION CONTINUES TO THRIVE OVER MN SWWD INTO ERN SD AT MIDDAY COURTESY OF WEAK LOW/MID-LVL WARM ADVECTION. ACTIVITY SHOULD PERSIST INTO THE AFTN AS AN ASSOCIATED WEAK WAVE AND SFC TROUGH MOVE ACROSS THE REGION. A FEW STORMS WILL PROBABLY BECOME SFC-BASED LATER THIS AFTN OVER PORTIONS OF MN WHERE AN AXIS OF MLCAPE TO 3000 J/KG WILL EXIST. DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE MODEST...35 KTS ON AVERAGE...AND A FEW STRONGER STORMS MAY POSE A LARGE HAIL/GUSTY WIND THREATS. ..RACY/COHEN.. 07/20/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING SEVERE THREAT THAT COULD REQUIRE A WATCH BY EARLY AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-LEVEL FLOW STILL APPEARS GENERALLY SUBSIDENT ALONG THE EASTERN FRINGE OF A 50-60 KT SOUTHERLY 500 MB JET STREAK LIFTING THROUGH EASTERN OREGON AND WASHINGTON. BUT CLEAR TO PARTLY CLOUDY CONDITIONS ARE ALLOWING FOR CONSIDERABLE INSOLATION...AND DESTABILIZATION OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THE WALLOWA/BLUE MOUNTAINS VICINITY NORTHWARD THROUGH MUCH OF THE COLUMBIA BASIN. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSES AND MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THAT CAPE IS IN THE PROCESS OF BECOMING MODERATELY LARGE...ON THE ORDER OF 1000 TO 2000 J/KG...AND THIS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME SUPPORTIVE OF VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS MID-LEVEL FORCING FOR ASCENT INCREASES AHEAD OF AN UPPER TROUGH BEGINNING TO LIFT NORTHEAST OF THE CASCADES. GUIDANCE INDICATES STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY INITIATE AS EARLY AS 18-19Z...BEFORE INCREASING IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY DURING THE AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS WITH AT LEAST A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS ARE MORE UNCERTAIN...BUT AN ISOLATED TORNADO MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION...PARTICULARLY EAST OF THE SURFACE LOW...NEAR/NORTH OF THE YAKIMA VALLEY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PARTS OF THE ARKLAMISS REGION INTO WRN ALABAMA ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASE IN THE POTENTIAL FOR SVR THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND THE POTENTIAL NEED FOR A SVR THUNDERSTORM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PLETHORA OF BOUNDARIES IS ANALYZED ACROSS THE ARKLAMISS INTO WRN AL AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON...AND THE MORE SALIENT ONES FOR FOCUSING CONVECTIVE INITIATION FOLLOW: /1/ A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LIES APPROXIMATELY ALONG THE I-20 CORRIDOR FROM E OF SHREVEPORT PASSING S OF MONROE AND EXTENDING FARTHER EAST TO THE JACKSON METRO AREA AND THEN FARTHER NE TOWARD TUSCALOOSA. THIS BOUNDARY WILL CONTINUE TO SAG SWD/ESEWD...AND PERHAPS SERVE AS A ZONE FOR INITIATION. /2/ A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM CNTRL AR TO WRN TN IS OVERLAID BY ABUNDANT DRY AIR ALOFT ON THE BACKSIDE OF A SERN-CONUS/N-CNTRL GULF OF MEXICO MID-TROPOSPHERIC TROUGH. HOWEVER...A LEADING MOISTURE DISCONTINUITY CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM NORTH MS TO CNTRL AR AND MAY ALSO BE A FOCUS REGION FOR INITIATION BY MID-AFTERNOON. /3/ A SFC CONFLUENCE AXIS THAT INTERSECTS THE COLD FRONT BETWEEN JACKSON TN AND MEMPHIS ALSO EXTENDS FARTHER S ACROSS ERN MS BEFORE ARCING SWWD INTO SERN LA...WHERE IT BECOMES OBSCURED BY ONGOING COASTAL CONVECTION. PROBABLE ASCENT ALONG THIS AXIS -- AND ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM COASTAL CONVECTION -- MAY ALSO AID IN ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. THE AIR MASS ACROSS THE REGION IS RATHER MOIST...WITH THE JACKSON MS AND SLIDELL LA 12Z RAOBS INDICATING PW AROUND 2.1 INCHES. THIS WILL ENHANCE PRECIPITATION-LOADING PROCESSES WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS. FURTHERMORE...MODIFICATIONS TO THESE SOUNDINGS TO ACCOUNT FOR CURRENT SFC OBSERVATIONS SUGGEST SUBSTANTIAL EROSION TO NOCTURNAL-GENERATED CINH WITH MLCAPE AOA 2000 J/KG...AND STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP WITHIN THE 1830Z-2000Z TIME-FRAME. WHILE DEEP SHEAR IS RATHER WEAK...JACKSON VWP DATA INDICATE NWLY/NNWLY 20-25 KT FLOW EXTENDING FROM 1-5 KM AGL. THIS WILL LIKELY SUPPORT MULTICELL CLUSTERS/SMALL FORWARD-PROPAGATING LINE SEGME

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT WILL EXIST THIS AFTERNOON. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED ACROSS THE AREA...AND A SVR TSTM WATCH MIGHT BE NEEDED THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A LONG FETCH OF MOIST SWLY/WSWLY FLOW EAST OF A MID-TROPOSPHERIC TROUGH AXIS EXTENDING FROM NEW ENGLAND SSWWD TO THE N-CNTRL GULF COAST...A PLUME OF DEEP MOISTURE OVERLAYS THE MID-ATLANTIC AND CAROLINAS CONSISTING OF 1.9-2.2-INCH PW VALUES. AMIDST THIS RICH DEEP MOISTURE...THE FOLLOWING ENTITIES WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO SERVE AS FOCI FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION THROUGH THE AFTERNOON: /1/ A DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE ARCING FROM UPSTATE SC THROUGH WRN NC AND INTO SRN/SERN VA.../2/ A BOUNDARY -- PERHAPS A REMNANT/DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY -- EXTENDING FROM THE OUTER BANKS WSWWD INTO S-CNTRL NC TO JUST SOUTH OF THE GREENVILLE-SPARTANBURG AREA.../3/ A SFC LEE TROUGH LYING NE-SW OVER THE PIEDMONT REGION.../4/ PERHAPS HIGHER TERRAIN INVOF THE SRN APPALACHIANS...AND /5/ SEA-BREEZE CIRCULATIONS OVER THE COASTAL PLAIN. AREAS OF STRONG INSOLATION/DIABATIC HEATING ON THE WARM SIDE OF THE DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-2000 J/KG...WHICH WILL SUPPORT VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. MULTICELL CLUSTERS/SMALL LINE SEGMENTS MAY EVOLVE AMIDST 15-25 KT OF SWLY/WSWLY FLOW EVIDENT THROUGH THE 1.5-6-KM-AGL LAYER PER AREA VWP DATA. DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH THIS ACTIVITY...AIDED BY WATER-LOADING PROCESSES. HOWEVER...WITH ONLY MODEST MID-LEVEL FLOW OVER THE REGION...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR MAGNITUDES ARE GENERALLY 30 KT OR LESS WHICH SHOULD LIMIT THE OVERALL CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION. WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD ALSO MITIGATE THE OVERALL SVR THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED RISK FOR SVR STORMS MAY EXIST THIS AFTERNOON...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AREAS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY HAVE DEVELOPED AMIDST A MOIST AIR MASS IN PLACE ACROSS THE AREA...WITH PW VALUES OF 1.85-2.10 INCHES PER GPS DATA. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY REVEALS A BROAD...MULTI-LAYERED CLOUD DECK FROM NERN GA INTO CNTRL AL...WHICH IS LIKELY INHIBITING DESTABILIZATION TO SOME DEGREE. NEVERTHELESS...MULTIPLE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES BENEATH THIS CLOUD DECK AMIDST RICH DEEP MOISTURE...ALONG WITH BAROCLINIC CIRCULATIONS OVER PERIPHERAL DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONES...WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED STRONG STORMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...WITH LOWER/MIDDLE-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW GENERALLY AOB 20 KT PER BIRMINGHAM/ATLANTA VWP DATA...DEEP SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEAK AND SUPPORT A PREDOMINANTLY PULSE CONVECTIVE MODE. REGARDLESS...PRECIPITATION-LOADING PROCESSES WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR GUSTY WINDS WITH WET MICROBURSTS...AND PERHAPS SPORADIC INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: IT IS NOT CERTAIN THAT THE SEVERE THREAT WILL BECOME SUFFICIENT TO REQUIRE A WW ISSUANCE...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THAT POSSIBILITY LATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS INDICATES THAT HEATING OF THE MOIST PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY LAYER IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATELY LARGE CAPE /2000+ J PER KG/ AND WEAKENING INHIBITION ACROSS NORTHERN MINNESOTA INTO NORTHWESTERN ONTARIO. THIS IS OCCURRING ON THE NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGING...WHICH HAS FLATTENED/ BECOME SUPPRESSED BY A SIGNIFICANT MID-LEVEL CLOSED LOW AND ASSOCIATED SHORT WAVE TROUGH PROGRESSING EASTWARD ACROSS NORTHERN MANITOBA INTO HUDSON BAY AND ADJACENT AREAS OF ONTARIO. SCATTERED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS FAR SOUTH AS THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER AREA OF MINNESOTA APPEARS POSSIBLE DURING THE 21-00Z TIME FRAME ...WITH A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION ACROSS/NORTH OF THE MINNESOTA ARROWHEAD AND WESTERN LAKE SUPERIOR PERHAPS PROVIDING SUPPORT FOR THE EVOLUTION OF A SMALL STORM CLUSTER. AT LEAST ONE OR TWO STORMS APPEAR POSSIBLE NEAR OR SOUTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER LATE THIS AFTERNOON...IN THE PRESENCE OF 20-30 KT WEST NORTHWESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW...WITH SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR SVR STORMS MAY EXIST THIS AFTERNOON...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WWD-EXPANDING...LOOSELY ORGANIZED COLD POOL APPEARS TO BE EVOLVING FROM ONGOING CLUSTERS OF STRONG STORMS FROM THE WEST END OF LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN TO ATCHAFALAYA BAY. THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS COLD POOL WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE INTO A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS OVER S-CNTRL LA...WITH MLCAPE OVER 3000 J/KG INDICATED BY MODIFIED LAKE CHARLES 12Z SOUNDING. SCATTERED CONVECTIVE REGENERATION WILL CONTINUE TO BE FAVORED OVER THE WRN FLANK OF THE COLD POOL...AS WEAK WLY FLOW NEAR THE SFC PERSISTS WITHIN THE PRE-CONVECTIVE ENVIRONMENT. AS SUCH...CONVECTION COULD REACH SWRN LA BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. PW VALUES OVER 2 INCHES PER GPS DATA WILL SUPPORT PRECIPITATION-LOADING PROCESS...WITH A THREAT FOR WET MICROBURSTS SUPPORTING SPORADIC INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND GENERALLY WEAK LOW/MID-LEVEL FLOW SHOULD PREVENT A MORE ORGANIZED SVR THREAT FROM ENSUING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS LIKELY WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE WW AREA AT LEAST ANOTHER 2-3 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DISCRETE VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS...IS NOW WELL UNDERWAY ACROSS THE COLUMBIA BASIN...AND PARTS OF THE WALLOWA/BLUE MOUNTAINS EASTWARD INTO THE BITTERROOTS. FOCUS FOR STRONGEST DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE 23-00Z TIME FRAME WILL SHIFT EASTWARD OUT OF EASTERN WASHINGTON INTO NORTHERN IDAHO...AS A 40-50 KT 500 MB JET STREAK NOSES NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF NORTHEAST OREGON. UNTIL THEN...LARGE HAIL WILL LIKELY REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH STORMS...AND SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS IN THE PEAK AFTERNOON HEATING MAY SUPPORT INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..KERR.. 07/20/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A VERY ISOLATED SVR MICROBURST POTENTIAL WILL EXIST THIS AFTERNOON...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OKLAHOMA MESONET OBSERVATIONS INDICATE THAT A SFC HOT-THERMAL AXIS -- TEMPS FROM 105 TO 109 DEGREES -- ARCS FROM NW OK THROUGH THE OKC METRO AREA AND FARTHER SE INTO SERN OK. A SFC TROUGH ALIGNS WITH THERMAL AXIS...WITH A REMNANT/DIFFUSE STATIONARY FRONT DRAPED NEARLY W-E JUST NORTH OF THE THERMAL AXIS. OVERLAPPING THE SRN FRINGES OF THE HOTTEST SFC TEMPERATURES...A RIBBON OF ENHANCED MID-LEVEL MOISTURE PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY EXTENDS FROM THE ERN TX PANHANDLE TROUGH SRN OK/NRN TX AND FARTHER EAST ACROSS SRN AR/NRN LA...WITH 700-MB DEWPOINTS IN EXCESS OF 6C PER 12Z RAOBS. DEEP BOUNDARY-LAYER CIRCULATIONS AMIDST THIS RELATIVE MAXIMUM IN MOISTURE HAVE ALLOWED VERY ISOLATED STORMS TO DEVELOP. THIS DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN AIDED BY ASCENT ALONG THE TROUGH...AND PERHAPS BY A REMNANT MID-LEVEL CIRCULATION NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF I-35 AND THE RED RIVER WHICH HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY ILL-DEFINED THROUGH THE DAY. WEAK FLOW THROUGH THE LOW/MID LEVELS PER AREA VWP DATA WILL FOSTER A PULSE CONVECTIVE MODE AND DISORGANIZED CONVECTION...MOVING SLOWLY SSWWD/SWWD. HOWEVER...VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OWING TO THE HOT SFC TEMPERATURES -- SUPPORTING DCAPE WELL IN EXCESS OF 1000 J/KG -- WILL PROMOTE STRONG MICROBURSTS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. GIVEN THESE THERMODYNAMIC CONDITIONS...VERY ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SVR WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN INCREASING SEVERE THREAT WHICH COULD REQUIRE A WW LATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEEPENING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING ACROSS THE ROCKIES... WHICH WILL GRADUALLY SHIFT ACROSS AND EAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN BETWEEN NOW AND 23-00Z...AS 20 KT SOUTHERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW BEGINS TO STRENGTHEN SOME...WITH THE NORTHEASTWARD MIGRATION OF A 40-50 KT 500 MB JET STREAK OUT OF OREGON. THE ENVIRONMENT EAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN IS NOT PARTICULARLY UNSTABLE IN TERMS OF CAPE...BUT LAPSE RATES ARE STEEP...AND THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS BECOMING DEEPLY WELL MIXED. AIDED BY INCREASING SHEAR...AND LARGE-SCALE FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING SHORT WAVE TROUGH...ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING THE RISK FOR SUPERCELLS...DOES NOT APPEAR OUT OF THE QUESTION...PARTICULARLY TO THE WEST AND SOUTHWEST OF CUT BANK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS THE NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND SD/BLACK HILLS VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE...AT LEAST ON AN ISOLATED BASIS...INTO THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AT MID-AFTERNOON IN SEVERAL GENERAL AREAS ACROSS THE REGION. THIS INCLUDES NORTHWEST NEB/SOUTHWEST SD WITHIN A HOT/DEEP MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER IN VICINITY OF A SOUTHWEST-NORTHEAST ORIENTED SURFACE TROUGH...WHERE A 41 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY NOTED AT PINE RIDGE SD. THIS IS IN ADDITION TO INITIALLY MORE ISOLATED OROGRAPHICALLY/UPSLOPE AIDED DEVELOPMENT JUST NORTHWEST OF THE RAPID CITY AREA AS OF 21Z...NEAR/NORTH OF A WEAK FRONT. TSTMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND SPREAD EASTWARD INTO EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL SD AND NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL NEB. WHILE TOTAL BUOYANCY IS MODEST AND VERTICAL SHEAR IS WEAK ESPECIALLY ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN SD/NORTHERN NEB...HOT/DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND A HIGH DCAPE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT SOME POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL INTO THIS EVENING. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY BE AIDED LATER THIS EVENING BY A NOCTURNALLY INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET ACROSS SD NEAR/NORTH OF THE WEAK FRONT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WILL PROBABLY CONTINUE FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO ACROSS SWRN SD EARLY THIS EVENING. THE MAIN THREAT SHOULD BE FOR WIND DAMAGE BUT HAIL ALSO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. THE THREATS SHOULD BE TOO MARGINAL FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING NEAR THE WY-SD STATE-LINE TO THE WEST OF RAPID CITY JUST SOUTH OF A POCKET OF ANALYZED MODERATE INSTABILITY. MLCAPE VALUES NEAR THE CONVECTION ARE ESTIMATED AROUND 1000 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON THE RAPID CITY WSR-88 VWP SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A SEVERE THREAT. THE LINE IS LOCATED JUST TO THE NORTH OF THE FRONT WHICH IS PROVIDING SOME FORCED ASCENT WHICH COULD HELP MAINTAIN THE CONVECTION FOR AWHILE. THE LINE IS MOVING ABOUT 25 KT WHICH SHOULD TAKE IT EWD INTO THE RAPID CITY AREA AROUND 01Z. WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE LINE. HOWEVER...TEMPS ALOFT ARE VERY WARM AND AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE IS IN PLACE ACROSS WRN SD. THESE TWO FACTORS SHOULD LIMIT THE SEVERE THREAT COVERAGE WITH THE WINDOW FOR SEVERE BEING CONFINED TO THE EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY DIMINISH FROM SOUTHWEST TO NORTHEAST ACROSS THE NRN PART OF WW 499 EARLY THIS EVENING. FOR THIS REASON...THE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE CANCELED BEFORE THE 03Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE STILL ONGOING IN NWRN MT IN THE NERN PART OF WW 499 WHERE AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXISTS. THE STORMS ARE LOCATED JUST AHEAD OF A NEGATIVELY-TILTED UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WITH SUBSTANTIAL DRYING EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY JUST TO THE SOUTHWEST OF THE CONVECTION. AS THE STORMS MOVE NEWD INTO SRN CANADA OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD RAPIDLY DIMINISH AS THE DRY SLOT MOVES NEWD ACROSS NRN ID AND NWRN MT. AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT COULD CONTINUE NORTH OF GREAT FALLS NEAR CUT BANK AND EWD ALONG THE I-15 CORRIDOR WHERE MODERATE INSTABILITY SHOULD REMAIN FOR AWHILE LONGER. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE IN THIS AREA BUT THE THREAT SHOULD BE TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT THE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WATCH. ..BROYLES.. 07/21/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THREAT EXPECTED THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS BAND OF STORMS TRACKS W/SWD. SMALL AERIAL EXTENT AND SHORT DURATION OF POTENTIAL SEVERE THREAT MAY MITIGATE THE NEED FOR A SEVERE WW...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BAND OF STORMS FROM CNTRL LA SWD TO THE GULF COAST WILL CONTINUE TRACKING W/SW THIS EVENING TOWARD AN AXIS OF SLIGHTLY HIGHER INSTABILITY NEAR THE PORT ARTHUR AREA. DEEP LAYER FLOW HAS INCREASED SINCE EARLIER THIS AFTERNOON TO AROUND 20-30 KT PER LCH AND POE VWP/S AND 00Z MESOANALYSIS...LEADING TO SLIGHTLY BETTER ORGANIZED STORMS. MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 6-6.5 DEG C PER KM AND MODERATE TO STRONG DOWNSTREAM INSTABILITY /PER LCH OOZ RAOB/ WILL ALSO HELP TO MAINTAIN THUNDERSTORM UPDRAFTS FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. AT LEAST AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THREAT WILL ACCOMPANY THESE STORMS. GIVEN THE SMALL AFFECTED AREA AND SHORT DURATION OF POTENTIAL SEVERE THREAT...A WW MAY NOT BE NEEDED BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED SHOULD A MORE WIDESPREAD THREAT EVOLVE.
